title: Refrigerant-History Credit on Line-Set Change Orders for Replacement System Installations
content:
# Refrigerant-history credit on a line-set change order

## Rule

The refrigerant-history credit on a line-set change order of a Replacement System Installations project is worked out from the homeowner's Harbison service calls — the Repair and Emergency Service Calls invoices — in the 24 months before the date of handling:

- where those calls billed both a refrigerant leak search and refrigerant, the credit is the refrigerant leak search labor billed on them, since that search located the leak the new line set cures;
- where they billed refrigerant but no refrigerant leak search, the credit is the most recent refrigerant charge billed;
- where they billed no refrigerant, no refrigerant-history credit is given.

## The records read

On a Repair and Emergency Service Calls invoice:

- a **refrigerant leak search** is a repair labor line whose task is the refrigerant leak search; the credit in the first case is the total of every such labor line billed in the 24 months;
- **refrigerant** is a refrigerant charge line; the credit in the second case is the single most recent refrigerant line billed.

Only service charges posted in the 24 months before the date of handling decide which case applies.

## Truth table

| Refrigerant leak search labor billed in the 24 months | Refrigerant billed in the 24 months | Refrigerant-history credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Total of the refrigerant leak search labor lines |
| No | Yes | The most recent refrigerant charge |
| Yes | No | None |
| No | No | None |

## Cases (hypothetical service histories)

- Two service calls in the last 24 months billed a $189.00 refrigerant leak search and $310.00 of refrigerant: the credit is $189.00, the leak search labor.
- Calls in the last 24 months billed refrigerant of $240.00 and, later, $280.00, and no leak search: the credit is $280.00, the most recent refrigerant charge.
- A refrigerant leak search billed 14 months ago with no refrigerant billed in the 24 months: no credit.
- Refrigerant billed 30 months ago and nothing since: no credit, because nothing falls in the 24 months.
